description: Arithmetic right shift by a variable amount with rounding (round half up), written to avoid overflow (silk_RSHIFT_ROUND)
notes: Opus 1.5.2, silk_RSHIFT_ROUND macro (silk/SigProc_FIX.h), with an opus_int32 value and a variable shift. The shift == 1 case is special-cased in the macro because the general form would compute (a >> 0) + 1, which overflows at INT32_MAX. Written by us from the macro. clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake keeps a branch on shift == 1 and a phi: 13 IR instructions. Shift amounts outside [1, 32] are UB in the source (the macro requires shift > 0). Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
